tools.name: greenrope_list_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by id, email, first or last name, or group. Returns the matching contacts and TotalMatchingContacts. Use start_chunk_page and start_chunk_size to page through large results. XML API: GetContactsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts with a text filter, sort order and page number. Returns the matching contacts and TotalMatchingContacts. XML API: SearchContactsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_get_contact_groups
tools.description: List the groups that one contact belongs to, matched by contact id, email or name. XML API: GetContactGroupsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_groups
tools.description: List contact groups, or one group by id or name. XML API: GetGroupsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_user_defined_fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields the account defines, with their types and possible values. XML API: GetUserDefinedFieldsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_crm_activity_types
tools.description: List the CRM activity types (labels) that the account can use when it records an activity. XML API: GetCRMActivityTypesRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_list_crm_activities
tools.description: List CRM activities, such as calls, tasks and notes, filtered by contact, group, type or date range. XML API: GetCRMActivitiesRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_add_contacts
tools.description: Create one or more contacts (up to 50 per call), each identified by its email address. This writes to the GreenRope contact list. XML API: AddContactsRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_add_contacts_to_group
tools.description: Add existing contacts to a group, by group id or group name. Each contact is given by contact id or email. This changes group membership. XML API: AddContactsToGroupRequest.

tools.name: greenrope_add_crm_activity
tools.description: Record one CRM activity (for example a note or a task) against a contact. The activity label must match one from greenrope_list_crm_activity_types. XML API: AddCRMActivitiesRequest.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_add_contacts · Private data: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_search_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_list_groups, greenrope_list_user_defined_fields, greenrope_list_crm_activity_types, greenrope_list_crm_activities, greenrope_add_contacts, greenrope_add_contacts_to_group, greenrope_add_crm_activity · Public sink: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_add_contacts, greenrope_add_contacts_to_group.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_add_contacts · Private data: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_search_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_list_groups, greenrope_list_user_defined_fields, greenrope_list_crm_activity_types, greenrope_list_crm_activities, greenrope_add_contacts, greenrope_add_contacts_to_group, greenrope_add_crm_activity · Public sink: greenrope_list_contacts, greenrope_get_contact_groups, greenrope_add_contacts, greenrope_add_contacts_to_group

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
